settings.title: Payments
settings.text: Buy-now items are paid in full. Quoted work requires a 50% deposit, with the balance due before printing, pickup, shipping, or final-file release.

settings.title: Proofs and revisions
settings.text: Two design rounds are included. One round means one complete list of changes submitted together. Additional rounds are $15.

settings.title: Turnaround
settings.text: Digital files 3-5 business days. Paper goods and single items 5-7. Apparel bundles and 3D sublimation 7-10. Large orders and Full Moment suites 10-15.

settings.title: Rush work
settings.text: Rush is 25% with a $25 minimum and must be confirmed in writing before payment. No rush inside 5 business days of an event without approval.

settings.title: Shipping
settings.text: Local pickup is free. Shipping is $8 under $75 and free at $75 or more. Separate addresses route to quote. Local delivery is not offered at launch.

settings.title: Digital files
settings.text: Made to order and delivered by email after proof approval. Personal use only. Final sale once delivered. A second design requires a second file purchase.

settings.title: Original concepts
settings.text: CCC retains ownership of original concepts and working files unless transferred in writing. Unpaid proofs may not be copied, printed, or used.
